newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 5.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 5.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A task group of the Socialists, the senior party of the ruling coalition, said the Constitutional Court should lose its right for vetoing laws before they take affect.
- Unknown fraudsters sent letters to many people, saying that the Finance Ministry would regard their past as tax-payers clear if they paid 76,000 forints to a banking account.
- Representatives of handicapped people demand that the parliament should pass a law within one year to guarantee their equality with other people.
- Metesz, an organisation of farmers, plans to resume demonstrations in protest over the government's agricultural and tax policies, a daily paper said.
